WITH channel_averages AS (
  SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_fee_rate
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN fees AS f ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_fee_rate
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN fees AS f ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
)
SELECT AVG(c.avg_fee_rate) AS mean_channel_avg_fee_rate,
       AVG(c.avg_fee_rate - b.avg_fee_rate) AS mean_excess_over_benchmark
FROM channel_averages AS c
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE c.avg_fee_rate > b.avg_fee_rate;
